channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: 'Ashamed of my behavior': How 'monster' child molester got parole, sparking demands for action
item.description: Outrage over parole being granted to a convicted serial child molester who lured children with candy has renewed calls to reform California's elder parole program.

item.title: It starts with a tap on the shoulder and ends with being fleeced. Alleged ATM scam duo sought
item.description: An ATM con that involves some snooping, some acting and some sleight-of-hand is being carried out across Southern California, police say.

item.title: State-protected hawk given a joint, fed a BuzzBall on video by California man, officials say
item.description: Cesar Gustavo Diaz, 25, of Watts pleaded no contest to a misdemeanor charge of animal cruelty.

item.title: Mountain lion snags Declan the shih tzu 'feet away' from home's front door, Glendale woman says
item.description: Glendale nurse practitioner Laura McVay said a mountain lion snatched her shih tzu mere 'feet away from the door' and dragged the pet into the foothills.

item.title: D4vd is 'target' of grand jury murder probe into dismembered teen found in his Tesla
item.description: The singer has been the subject of the probe since November, months after 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez's dismembered body was found in his Tesla's front trunk.

item.title: This Latino Republican Trump speech watch party was neither large, nor especially Latino
item.description: It was the Los Angeles Hispanic Republican Club's potluck party for President Trump's State of the Union address, but there was a problem: Not many Hispanics showed up.

item.title: L.A. arts icon Judy Baca denies she used $5-million nonprofit grant for personal benefit
item.description: Judy Baca's former staff members allege she used the nonprofit art center SPARC for her personal gain. She strongly denies it.

item.title: Alberto Carvalho is a prominent education leader. Now, he's part of an FBI investigation
item.description: Carvalho joined LAUSD in 2022 as a nationally acclaimed education leader from Miami-Dade, known for improving academics and defying Gov. Ron DeSantis on pandemic mandates.

item.title: FBI raids of LAUSD Supt. Alberto Carvalho's home and office appear tied to AI chatbot probe
item.description: Federal authorities raided the home and office of Los Angeles Unified School District Supt. Alberto Carvalho in what appears to be a probe related to a company that developed an AI chatbot for the school system.

item.title: Tight California governor's race between five leading candidates
item.description: Three Democrats and two Republicans are in a statistical tie in the California governor's race. The top two vote-getters in the June primary will move on to the November general election to lead the state.
